format.description: Format names the format and its major version: pidl-binding/v1.

participants.description: Participants maps a document participant ID to how a capture names it.

labelsByPath.description:
LabelsByPath resolves a generic sender label, such as a trace's
"client", by the request path.

paths.description:
Paths gives, per participant, the path of a step where the
deployment's path differs from the document's example. Keys are step
addresses, as in Steps.

rewrite.description: Rewrite rewrites every exchange's URL before matching, in order.

unobservable.description:
Unobservable lists participants a capture cannot see, in addition to
those whose role type is user.

steps.description:
Steps replaces a step's rule for this deployment. A key is
"<scenario>/<step-id>", or "*/<step-id>" for every scenario that has
the step: step IDs repeat across scenarios. A scenario's key wins over
the wildcard.

Binding.description: Binding describes one deployment of a protocol, so observed exchanges can be matched to a document's steps: the labels a capturing tool uses for each participant and the hosts it answers at, paths that differ from the document's examples, URL rewrites a capture needs, and rules that replace a step's own for this deployment.

label.description: Label is the sender label the rule applies to, such as "client".

path.description: Path is a regular expression the request path must match.

participant.description: Participant is the participant the sender is taken to be.

BindingLabelRule.description: BindingLabelRule resolves a sender label by the request path.

labels.description: Labels are the capturing tool's names for the participant.

hosts.description: Hosts are the host names the participant answers at.

BindingParticipant.description: BindingParticipant is how a capture names one participant.

match.description: Match is a regular expression over the whole URL.

to.description: To is the replacement, with $1-style references to Match's groups.

BindingRewrite.description: BindingRewrite rewrites a URL by a regular expression.

BindingStep.description: BindingStep is a deployment's rule for one step.

path.description:
Path is a template, whose segments in braces match any one segment
("/pending/{id}"), or a regular expression when it starts with "^".

headers.description:
Headers maps a header name, compared without regard to case, to a
value: exact, a prefix when it ends with "*", or a regular expression
when it starts with "^". Response headers are searched before request
headers.

body.description:
Body maps a JSON pointer into the request body to the value it must
have, or to true when the member must merely exist.

repeat.description:
Repeat lets the step take every consecutive exchange that matches it,
such as a client polling.

optional.description: Optional lets a run omit the step without failing a check.

StepMatch.description: StepMatch is a rule that says which observed exchanges are a step.

title: PIDL Binding
description: How one deployment of a protocol names its participants, paths and steps, so observed exchanges can be matched to a document's steps.
